Self-care involves taking the time to look after ourselves, including taking care of our bodies and minds. This can include things like getting enough sleep, eating well, exercising regularly, and finding time for relaxation and fun.

Self-care is not just about pampering yourself, but also about cultivating a positive mindset and ensuring that you are taking care of yourself in a way that is healthy and sustainable. When we prioritize self-care, we are better able to handle stress, improve our mental health, and feel more energized and focused.
